_note: v4 findings catalog. A finding is ESTABLISHED when it has 3 independent sources (or all its sources, if it lists fewer than 3). Only established findings go on the board. 'need' = sources required.

findings.name: The office was bolted from inside
findings.text: The bolt was thrown on the inside and the window is barred. Nobody left by the door or the window.

findings.name: There is a way into the office through the floor
findings.text: Something under the office floor is hollow.

findings.name: Pryce died between 21:30 and 22:15
findings.text: The body's temperature, stiffness and the settled blood all point to the same window.

findings.name: He was poisoned, not a heart attack
findings.text: The signs on the body do not fit heart failure.

findings.name: The poison was cyanide, in the decanter
findings.text: The brandy in the decanter and in his glass test positive for cyanide.

findings.name: The darkroom's cyanide jar is a scoop short
findings.text: The darkroom's cyanide jar is a scoop short.

findings.name: Someone wound the music box after Pryce died
findings.text: The music box was playing at ten o'clock, after he was dead.

findings.name: A small, narrow, burn-scarred hand touched the decanter and music box
findings.text: A small, narrow, burn-scarred hand touched the decanter and music box.

findings.name: The 'gunshot' was a backfire; the revolver was never fired
findings.text: The revolver in the drawer is clean and fully loaded.

findings.name: The blackout was lightning; Hobbs reset the power
findings.text: The blackout was lightning; Hobbs reset the power.

findings.text: The blotter on the desk still shows: ZÜRICH 0500 / 2 PASS.

findings.name: Pryce was about to confess something
findings.text: His calendar for today reads 'END IT', and a half-burnt letter in the safe speaks of ending 'the silence'.
